q1.question: [TRANSLATE: What does the video creation process include?]
q1.answer: [TRANSLATE: Our platform provides a complete end-to-end solution: AI-powered script generation, professional voice synthesis with 200+ voices, and automated video production with matching visuals. You can use all three together or each component independently.]

q2.question: [TRANSLATE: How long does it take to create a video?]
q2.answer: [TRANSLATE: A typical 2-3 minute video can be created in under 10 minutes. The AI handles scriptwriting, voice generation, and video assembly automatically, dramatically reducing production time compared to traditional methods.]

q3.question: [TRANSLATE: Can I customize the AI-generated content?]
q3.answer: [TRANSLATE: Absolutely. You have full control at every step—edit scripts, choose voices, adjust pacing and tone, customize visuals, and add your branding. The AI accelerates the process while you maintain creative control.]

q4.question: [TRANSLATE: What types of videos can I create?]
q4.answer: [TRANSLATE: Marketing videos, product demos, training content, social media posts, explainer videos, corporate communications, and more. Our AI adapts to your needs and style requirements.]
